name: l2_scn_0911_the_captured_pillar_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0911 (The Captured Pillar) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A legacy institution that once stabilized society is internally captured by a demagogue promising restoration of 'former glory.' The institution's legitimacy becomes a weapon. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.

scenario_seed_overlay.objective: Prevent institutional capture from converting legitimacy into coercion - or, if aligned with the captor, consolidate control before resistance coheres.
scenario_seed_overlay.opposition: Factional splits, procedural loopholes, narrative advantage, and inertia.
roles: External Counterweight (courts, rivals, press, foreign powers)

knobs.Institution strength: strong guardrails vs weak norms vs captured courts
knobs.Transparency: plural info vs controlled narrative vs rumor swarm
knobs.Mobility: local capture -> regional cascade -> national takeover

scenario_seed_overlay.ethical_hook: When stability relies on legitimacy, how do you defend legitimacy without becoming illegitimate?
expected_end_state_categories: Capture succeeds; institution becomes regime arm; 'glory' hardens into doctrine
Partial capture; long internal cold war
Counter-capture restores independence, with lasting scars
Schism: rival claimants each assert authenticity
Collapse: legitimacy burns out; society scrambles for a new stabilizer
scenario_seed_overlay.end_state_handling: observation categories for branch coverage; not required endings
